SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS count,
    COALESCE(
        json_agg(t ORDER BY t.debut),
        '[]'::json
    ) AS slots
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.id,
        s.code AS service,
        si.code AS site,
        c.debut,
        c.fin,
        c.capacite,
        c.places_reservees,
        (c.capacite - c.places_reservees) AS places_disponibles
    FROM creneaux c
    JOIN services s
        ON s.id = c.service_id
    JOIN sites si
        ON si.id = c.site_id
    WHERE s.code = $1
      AND si.code = $2
      AND c.debut >= $3::date
      AND c.debut < ($4::date + INTERVAL '1 day')
      AND c.statut = 'DISPONIBLE'
      AND c.places_reservees < c.capacite
      AND c.debut > NOW()
) t;
